title: Hal warns of 33 million volts

tellings.quote: The how was telling me that they knew the voltage was like 33 million volts in one of these things.

plain: The craft or lights Chris Bledsoe encountered in North Carolina in 2007 carried something like 33 million volts. Bledsoe, who says he has had repeated UFO encounters, relays this from a man he calls Hal Pavvenmeer, who told him that people knew the voltage of one of these things. If true, the objects would hold enormous electrical power, dangerous to anyone near them.
